stage: Bounded workflow prepared, no geometry built

sequence.before_mesh: Keep related underside photo separate from current official target; record uncalibrated view, editable outline/camera hypotheses and authored scale ranges.
sequence.method: Independent outline stations and gentle longitudinal plate-height controls, finite wall closing only plate material. Exclude ribs/supports/foam at first gray pass. No full generic seat underside or hidden top padding.
sequence.review: Whole gray, underside and reflective macro; source/export finite area/UV/normals before adding features.

sequence.method: One observed opening/ledge at a time, separate observed projected shape from estimated depth. Actual holes in finite plate, no black fake decal or fabricated foam filling.
sequence.review: Hole wall/UV/normal and local intersection checks; distinguish six bright regions from support-hole features.

sequence.method: Trace only visible rib runs and intersections, no automatically completed lattice across occlusions. Build intended junction radii before unions; avoid beveling triangulated CSG globally.
sequence.review: Raking reflection and actual normals/area, one rib group before repeating genuinely observed runs.

sequence.method: Read one clearest ribbed block and central feature, model independently with explicit authored dimensions and unresolved through/blind hole. Apply seven placements only as observed related pattern, not current mount datums.
sequence.review: Isolated gray/reflective and PBR, then separate placement diagnostic.

sequence.method: Independent editable observed silhouettes, estimated depth/root, no invented latch mechanism.
sequence.review: One projection before any justified related duplicate; hidden/top faces unresolved.

sequence.method: Separate original black return and finite metallic staples only where visible, no invented global exact pitch/count.
sequence.review: Actual macro and underside whole; not physical upholstery stitching/stapling certification.

scale_status: No manufacturer base length/width/thickness or attachment cotes. Any construction dimensions will be marked authored estimates and not reconstructed from wheelbase or a single photo.
integration: Frozen exterior is a separate candidate. Any later base/envelope relation must be checked in disposable assembly, never by silently deforming either source.
